{{Hatnote|1=Transcript of a YouTube interview about ''Star Wars'' CCG history and collecting.}}
'''Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson''' (24 April 2022) is a 79-minute BoardMatt interview with [[Jim Colson]] (Gold 5), a Decipher-era volunteer tournament director and later [[Players Committee]] advocate. Topics include his tournament circuit in Alabama and Tennessee, shields, Premiere Blue and Cartamundi printing, the delay of ''Alternate Universe'' in customs, Decipher's plans for relic cards and graded cards before the license ended, two-player sets, DecipherCon tournament foils, Reflections Gold, and the Krayt Dragon. Participants: Matt (BoardMatt, host), Cam, Mark (Darth Grader), [[Jim Colson]].

Source: [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PRRkRBHlo-o Star Wars CCG INSIDER Stories, History & Collector Tips from the legend Jim Colson], BoardMatt, YouTube (uploaded 24 April 2022).

''The text below is from the video's automatic captions, corrected for names and card titles; it has not yet been checked against the audio. Speakers are identified from context; some questions are labelled Interviewer where the speaker is unclear. Words that could not be made out are marked [unclear].''
